pmqdydwa.variantName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Pre-Lit Bianca Pine - Warm White Lights
pmqdydwa.sourceDescription: White Christmas trees are now hugely popular with our customers, loved for their frosty look and stunning backdrop to darker Xmas decorations. And none achieve the dreamy Winter Wonderland experience quite like our pre-lit Bianca Pine trees! With wintry white foliage, it's easy to build your festive theme around this trend-setting, captivating Christmas colour. Beautiful and bushy, the pre-lit Bianca Pine features traditional PVC branch tips so you get a realistic tree that enjoys the same charming finish as our classic green Xmas trees. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Store in a Christmas tree storage bag or the original box. sdhreg99.variantName: HOMCOM 6ft Artificial Christmas Tree with Solid Pine Wood Stand - Green
sdhreg99.sourceDescription: Holiday setup can feel rushed, especially with pets or little ones nearby. The HOMCOM 6ft artificial Christmas tree eases that stress with auto-drop hinged tips that open more quickly. Crafted with 2081 dense PE and PVC tips, it delivers a full, realistic look. Flame-retardant materials add peace of mind during busy family moments, while a solid pine wood base brings a natural texture to your holiday decor. It helps your home feel festive, calm and ready for seasonal celebrations • Classic Christmas tree design features a full-bodied profile • Crafted with realistic PE and dense PVC leaves for long-lasting natural beauty • Hinged tips drop automatically, making shaping quicker than normal trees • Sectional trunks make storage compact once festivities end • Flame-retardant tips help slow accidental fire spread for safer celebrations • A solid pine wood base delivers robust stability and adds an elevated, textured natural look • Versatile seasonal accent infuses an authentic forest touch and a vibrant holiday atmosphere into any indoor layout • Colour: Green • Material: PE, PVC, Pine Wood • Overall Dimensions: Φ103 x 180H cm • Base Dimensions: Φ66 x 15H cm • Tip Count: 2081 • Item Label: 83C-293V01GN • Shaping Note: Approx. 30-50 minutes of manual branch shaping recommended to achieve maximum natural fullness Warning: for decoration only. Keep away from open flames, heaters and other heat sources. Ensure the product is stable before use. Keep small parts and packaging away from children. Stop using if damaged. 1 Northampton Cross Logistics Park Northampton Cross Road Northampton NN4 9FH

zg5wp25j.variantName: Christmas Tree World 5ft Pre-Lit Majestic Dew Pine Indoor/Outdoor Potted Tree
zg5wp25j.sourceDescription: Why save all the festivities for the indoors With these outdoor Christmas trees, you get to serve up a generous helping of Yuletide spirit to all your neighbours (and watch them turn green with envy!) With the same stunning PVC branches and large bottle brush branch tips of our indoor Pre-Lit Majestic Dew Pine tree and boasting a dazzling display of ready-lit foliage, these bushy Christmas trees deliver maximum festive impact for years to come. What's more, there's no need to research how to tie your 5ft pre-lit Christmas tree down - these beautiful rust-resistant trees arrive in an attractive weighted pot (extra pebbles can be added to provide additional protection against strong winds). Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom
